title: [TaCZ] Bring me 115! - Pack a Punch
description: Mine Element115, Infuse it into your guns, punch the fists into the air and RAISE THE REBEL!
body: First, I'm Japanese and oppsite of Richtofen, so what I wanna say: **"I'm sorry, I can not speak English!"** …Plz give your mercy to me :P ![Bring me 115's logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/762be7e4036ba11b7aab63da68abc40fad6a2f8d.png) # Bring me 115! - TaCZ addon This is "Bring me 115!", the addon of [Timeless and Classics Zero.](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero) I completely rewrote from scratch the [Pack-a-Punched](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tacz-pack-a-punched) for after TaCZ 1.1.8. If you want more Firepower , Use this mod! You need to find enough Element 115 ore, but it'll make your gun's damage more and more! This mod focus to integrate Minecraft Experience with CoD:Zombies and TaCZ. I wanna integrate with tech mods too, but im so lazy.... ###### _If you're feelin' underpowered, I'll help you make amends._ ## How to PaP your guns ![How to PaP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7533b606c516f6ea130a0bc6de3bace412dc94c7.png)   1. Find and mine some Deepslate Element115 Ores. I recommend to mine Y-54. 2. Make the "Primitive Pack-a-Punch Machine" from Raw Element115 and some stuffs. 3. Compless 9 of Raw Element115 to block, and porish to make Aetherium Crystal. 4. Infuse Aetherium Crystal into your guns through the Primitive PaP Machine! ###### _Few things in life are guaranteed, but I promise this won't suck._   ## GUI and HUD adjustment You can check the PaP level from Icon, Tooltip, and also HUD! ![HUD Adjustment](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0ed978481c016fc9258bc0b48668ad0b5d3a4f6.png) ## Config for Modpack Creator! You can set the Damage multiplier for each PaP level, and also you can set specified level to special multiplier! ![Config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a9bded7086d2b825b4c4d4940b007e915669737.png) If you use this mod to Modpack, go ahead mate......   ## About AI usage. This is my first mod. I'm Java noob. So, I heard a lot of things from Gemini... I need more learn about modding. Textures and Model and Sound were made myself. ## And something hidden...... ![what is this?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ad4091fd1641ab5a78a7916bdea9b2e08b6c326.png)
